comparison.objective: Open a glove box past paired stops and replace a cabin filter; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Simultaneous wall squeezing followed by filter extraction and slot insertion versus concentric screw/nut countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Safe stop passage, old filter removed, new filter seated, and hands clear versus locked 90° opening retained through cycles.
comparison.reason: Bimanual coordination is shared only at a generic level; the mechanisms and graded outcomes are different.
